answer: An identity earns its seat through proof of ownership of stored data, a proof that is cheap to make once and ruinous to fake at scale. One honest agent clears the check in 16 minutes; a farm of 779 pays 12464 minutes every epoch, a standing bill no payout covers. One timber of signal, one vine of cost, one echo of evidence: that is the whole test, and a farm fails all three at once. Cheap for one, ruinous for a thousand — that asymmetry is the entire point.
